scope: trusted verifier routing, not adversarial-host isolation
productionBinding: worker.mjs passes its own import.meta.url as entryParentURL after authority/operation/view checks; never derived from import context or worker config
requiredEdges: exact admitted worker URL -> exact projected consumer URL
exact consumer URL -> bare library whose resolved URL is allowlisted

routePolicy.parent: required exact canonical file URL; no absent/undefined parent, query/fragment alias or alternate parent
routePolicy.consumerSpecifier: exact canonical absolute file URL generated by pathToFileURL; relative/percent/dot/query/fragment aliases are not admitted routes
routePolicy.normalization: canonicalization only identifies aliases for rejection, never rewrites or accepts them
routePolicy.resolvedConsumer: exact projected URL, strict file membership/hash/size/mode still required
routePolicy.unscopedControls: existing engine-less C03/C04/C12 fixture loader remains scope-less; actual engine worker always authenticates a fixed engine view
